properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDH key exchange usage in TLS configuration (support/http.php, support/pop3.php) - this uses classical ECDH key agreement that is retroactively breakable by quantum computers and needs migration to post-quantum alternatives.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ChaCha20-Poly1305 authenticated encryption in TLS (support/http.php, support/pop3.php) - while the AEAD cipher itself is quantum-safe, the ECDHE key exchange component is not and needs hybridization with post-quantum algorithms.
